title: Gorgeous plants!
text: Gorgeous plants!. I love these! I like having plants but Im not always good with watering them lol. These look like little bushes. They can be reshaped to look how you want after you take them out of the box. They look so real! The Rosemary looks like a small Christmas bush. I love the log shaped container they are in because they look just like a natural grey stone. I am so happy with them.
